_meta.label: Synthetic demonstration dataset shaped around PS 26017 variables
_meta.grounding_note: Distributions (states, project types, dominant delay causes, RFCTLARR stages) are shaped around patterns observed in data.gov.in Parliament-reply datasets and eParlib records researched for this project. Individual project names, IDs and figures are synthetic — no real, identifiable project's data is represented.
_meta.risk_formula: overall_risk_score = delay_probability(40%) + overdue_severity(20%) + compensation/RR_exposure(15%) + legal_exposure(15%) + data_freshness(10%) - stakeholder_responsiveness_bonus
